intent: The original anniversary dance photograph comes alive as the same couple performs one small slow-dance step and finishes smiling warmly at each other.

subjects.screen_position: frame left, facing frame right toward partner_man
subjects.identity_lock: Match the source dance photo and the two approved woman identity crops; preserve age, face proportions, responsive gaze and glasses.
subjects.wardrobe_lock: Burgundy patterned long dress, original hairstyle silhouette, hairline, bangs, major curl groups and original glasses remain unchanged frame to frame.

subjects.screen_position: frame right, facing frame left toward partner_woman
subjects.identity_lock: Match the source dance photo and the two approved man identity crops; preserve age, face proportions, engaged gaze toward partner_woman and a warm responsive expression.

timeline.state_change: The still photograph becomes alive through breathing and one natural blink. From the first live frame partner_man focuses on partner_woman with responsive eyes and reaches a faint warm micro-smile by 0.25 seconds; neither face is vacant or frozen.
partner_man gently shifts weight and partner_woman mirrors him without any hand or finger regrip.
The couple completes one small slow-dance step and an up-to-four-degree shared body rotation, then eases back while both heads remain nearly fixed relative to their shoulders.
Body motion decelerates, partner_woman opens her face slightly and both expressions warm into smiles.
Both partners hold the same dance grip, smile at each other and continue only subtle breathing.

camera.final_framing: identical to the approved last-frame anchor

audio.diegetic: not rendered in the first production cycle
audio.music: none in H3; optional instrumental slow waltz added in post
